journey.name: Payment Deadline History
journey.description: Requests with actual-payment deadlines are visible but cannot be paid by this version of Bitkit. Use a disposable Paykit test identity linked to a controlled rc56 peer. Prepare one-time BTC requests with deadlines in proposed, accepted, rejected, canceled and proof-submitted states, plus an accepted monthly BTC subscription with a period-start deadline, one paid period and one unpaid period. Acceptance and proof submission must be prepared through the controlled client because Bitkit intentionally cannot accept these terms. Use valid regtest payment proofs. Do not reset or replace a funded wallet to prepare this fixture.

actions.action: Open Subscriptions and select the Payments tab after the controlled peer's records have synchronized
Verify each one-time request remains visible with its lifecycle status, including the completed payment
Open the proposed and accepted one-time requests and verify neither offers a Pay action
Open the active subscription and verify its paid period remains visible and Cancel is available
Verify the unpaid period is not offered for payment in the Payments tab or pending-request sheet
Have the controlled peer send a new subscription proposal with a period-start deadline
Open that proposal and verify it is visible but cannot be accepted
Cancel the accepted subscription and verify its paid-period history remains accessible
Restart Bitkit and verify the one-time and subscription payment history is still visible
